text_block_list.text:
The last morning of summer camp is
here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All the Umamusume are boarding the
bus back to
Tracen Academy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There's no time left until the Kikuka
Sho...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! That's right! I'm the first-rate
Umamusume,
Кинг Хало!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Who's the smartest of them all?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
...Wait a second! This is no time for a call
and
response! Don't distract me!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I swear, keep your jokes in moderation.
We don't
have the time right now...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
As soon as summer is over, we have the
Kikuka
Sho—the last race of the Triple
Crown tour!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
It's a 3,000-meter long-distance race on
turf. It'll
be challenging, but I must
prevail...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало stares out the window on the
bus ride
back to the academy, lost in
thought.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
